title: Service Delivery Manager
description:
We are hiring a hands-on Service Delivery Manager to run day-to-day production support for our Big Data and data integration platforms. You will lead a support pod of L1/L2/L3 engineers, act as incident commander for critical outages, own SLA delivery, and drive the automation agenda that removes recurring manual work. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Incident & Problem Management Act as incident commander for P1/P2 production outages drive triage bridges, coordinate cross-team resolution, and manage business communication until service restoration. Own and deliver Root Cause Analysis (RCA) documentation within agreed SLAs; track corrective and preventive actions to closure. Run problem management for recurring issues; convert known errors into permanent fixes rather than repeated workarounds. SLA & Metric Governance Track, report, and enforce response and resolution SLAs across the ticket queue; manage backlog, ageing, and breach risk proactively. Publish weekly and monthly KPI packs MTTR, MTTD, SLA compliance, ticket volume and trend, availability, automation savings to leadership. Own the operational review cadence with business and technology stakeholders. People & Team Leadership Manage 16/7 or 24/7 rotational support rosters, shift handovers, on-call schedules, and holiday coverage. Mentor and coach support engineers; build technical depth and runbook discipline across the team. Conduct performance reviews, goal setting, and development planning; participate actively in interviewing, hiring, and onboarding. Automation & Continuous Improvement Identify high-frequency, high-effort manual tasks and replace them with automation scripts, self-healing routines, and auto-remediation. Improve monitoring and alerting frameworks to shift from reactive to predictive detection; reduce alert noise and false positives. Maintain and continually improve runbooks, knowledge base articles, and standard operating procedures. Cross-Team Collaboration Partner with software engineering, DevOps, and product teams to review upcoming deployments and assess release readiness. Represent support in CAB and change approval forums; enforce operational readiness criteria before production releases. Feed stability pain points, defect trends, and supportability gaps back into the development backlog. 
 Must Have Hands-on experience supporting Hadoop ecosystem components (HDFS, Hive, Spark, YARN, Sqoop, Oozie). Working experience with IBM InfoSphere DataStage — job design, scheduling, failure triage, and performance troubleshooting. Strong Splunk skills — building queries, dashboards, and alerts for log analysis and monitoring. Strong SQL for data validation, reconciliation, and issue investigation. Scripting/programming in Python , Java , or Shell for automation and tooling. ITIL-based Incident, Problem, and Change Management; ServiceNow or JIRA. Linux/Unix fundamentals and job scheduling tools (Control-M, Autosys, Airflow). 
 Good to Have Cloud data platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), Databricks, or Snowflake. CI/CD and DevOps tooling exposure (Jenkins, Git, Ansible). ITIL v4 Foundation certification.

As a manager, you will guide your team in working with open-source technologies like Kubernetes, Terraform, Argo, and Spinnaker, shaping the future of these technologies while fostering a culture of innovation. We manage one of the largest Kubernetes fleets in the industry and have been early adopters of this technology. The FKP team is critical to the company s strategy to move to Hyperforce, providing the underlying infrastructure for key services such as Sales, Service, Commerce, Mulesoft, and Tableau.

title: Analyst, Client Success
description:
About Us 
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. Job Description Job Summary The Client Success Analyst is an individual contributor responsible for managing a portfolio of Pismo clients predominantly in card issuing and ensuring they achieve their desired business outcomes from the Pismo platform. Acting as the primary day-to-day customer contact, the Analyst drives customer satisfaction, customer health, product adoption, revenue realization, and overall client success. This role will be based in Bangalore, India. The role combines customer relationship management, technical coordination, operational oversight, and business consulting. The Customer Success Analyst works independently to manage customer engagements while collaborating closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, Support, and Commercial teams to deliver customer outcomes. For complex situations, strategic opportunities, and executive escalations, the Analyst will partner with Customer Success leaders and management. The ideal candidate is customer-focused, technically competent, commercially aware, and capable of building trusted relationships with both operational and management-level stakeholders within client organizations and Pismo. 
 Key Responsibilities Customer Ownership & Business Outcomes Serve as the primary owner for an assigned portfolio of customer accounts. Develop a deep understanding of each customer's business objectives, operating model, and strategic priorities. Ensure customers achieve their desired outcomes through effective use of Pismo's card issuing platform. Build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders across operational, technical, and management levels. Lead regular operational reviews and governance discussions with customers. Act as the customer's advocate within Pismo and ensure commitments are delivered. Customer Health, Satisfaction & NPS Own and continuously improve Customer Health Scores for assigned customers. Drive customer satisfaction and Net Promoter Score (NPS) improvements through proactive engagement. Monitor customer sentiment, platform usage, service performance, and support trends to identify success opportunities and risks. Establish and execute action plans for customers showing signs of declining health. Drive proactive communication and follow-up to prevent escalations and strengthen customer confidence. Revenue Realization & Growth Ensure customers realize the value of their investment in the Pismo platform. Drive adoption of contracted products, features, and capabilities. Identify opportunities to increase platform utilization and business value. Support account planning activities by identifying expansion opportunities and revenue realization initiatives. Partner with Commercial and Account Management teams to contribute to revenue growth and retention objectives. Technical Coordination & Issue Management Develop strong knowledge of Pismo's card issuing platform, payment processing flows, APIs, product capabilities, and operational processes. Act as the coordination point between customers and internal Product, Engineering, SRE, Operations, and Support teams. Manage customer-reported issues through investigation, follow-up, communication, and resolution. Translate customer business requirements into actionable internal discussions. Ensure timely customer communication during incidents, enhancements, and platform changes. Stakeholder Management Build productive relationships with customer operational teams, program managers, product owners, and business leaders. Engage confidently with middle-management stakeholders and participate in discussions with senior leadership when required. Coordinate effectively across multiple internal teams to drive customer outcomes. Escalate risks, opportunities, and customer concerns appropriately to Customer Success leadership. Reporting & Insights Monitor and analyze customer performance metrics, health indicators, and adoption trends. Prepare customer scorecards, operational reports, governance materials, and business reviews. Identify trends, risks, and opportunities through data-driven analysis. Provide recommendations to improve customer experience, adoption, and operational efficiency. Success Measures The Customer Success Analyst will be accountable for: Customer Health Score improvement Net Promoter Score (NPS) Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) Revenue realization against contracted commitments Product adoption and engagement metrics Customer retention and renewal readiness Reduction in customer escalations Timely resolution and management of customer issues Delivery of customer success plans and agreed outcomes Positive customer and stakeholder feedback Qualifications Required Qualifications Bachelors Degree or an Advanced Degree 3-6 years of experience in Customer Success, Client Services, Technical Account Management, Program Management, Payments Operations, Consulting, or related fields. Experience within payments, card issuing, fintech, banking, SaaS, or technology industries. Strong understanding of customer lifecycle management and customer success principles. Ability to independently manage customer relationships and workstreams. Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills. Demonstrated ability to coordinate cross-functional teams and manage competing priorities. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
 Preferred Qualifications Knowledge of card issuing, authorization processing, disputes, settlement, digital wallets, and payment network ecosystems. Experience working with API-based platforms and modern cloud technologies. Familiarity with Visa and Mastercard issuing environments. Experience managing customer health programs, adoption tracking, and business reviews. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Assistant Quality Manager - (BPO)
description:
Assistant Manager - Quality (BPO) 
 About Us: TransMon helps businesses simplify and improve customer operations to deliver measurable and meaningful customer experiences. Our SaaS platform is used across India, UAE, South Africa, the US, and other markets, with 100,000+ users managing quality, workflows, and CX in real time. 
 About the Role We are looking for an Assistant Manager Quality to own the quality framework for our QMC process out of Bangalore. You will lead a team of Quality Analysts and Team Leads, own the quality metrics, and work directly with client stakeholders. As customer conversations move from human agents to voice bots and AI, you will also help shape how we audit them. 
 Key Responsibilities Quality Governance: Own the quality framework, audit forms, calibration and scoring methodology for the QMC process, keeping it consistent and aligned with client expectations. Metrics Ownership: Drive and deliver key quality metrics (Quality Score, Fatal %, CSAT/DSAT, Accuracy, Compliance) against agreed targets. Voice Bot & AI Audits: Build and run audit frameworks for voice bot and AI-led conversations, covering intent accuracy, response quality, compliance, escalation handling and tone, and feed findings back to improve the bot. Analytics & Insights : Analyze audit and customer data to find trends, root causes and improvement opportunities, and turn them into clear, actionable insights. Process Improvement: Lead LSS-based projects (RCA, CAPA, DMAIC) to reduce defects, repeat errors and customer pain points. Team Management : Lead, coach and develop Quality Analysts and Team Leads: allocate work, review performance and build a strong talent pipeline. Calibrations: Run regular internal and client calibration sessions to keep scoring aligned and reduce variance. Operations Partnership : Work closely with QAs, Training and WFM to close performance gaps through feedback, refreshers and targeted coaching. Stakeholder & Client Management: Prepare and present weekly and monthly quality reviews, dashboards and action plans to internal leadership and the client team. Reporting & Escalations: Ensure accurate, timely MIS and reporting; flag risks, escalations and compliance issues early, with corrective action plans. Culture & Compliance: Promote a customer-first, zero-CE and continuous-improvement culture, and make sure client and company policies are followed. 
 Required Skills & Qualifications Graduate in any discipline (degree mandatory). 6+ years of experience in customer experience; prior experience as Assistant Manager (1+ year) or Quality Team Leader (3+ years) preferred. LSS Green Belt certified. Strong people management and cross-functional leadership experience. Self-starter who can work with minimum supervision. Analytical, data-driven and result-oriented, with strong problem-solving and reasoning skills. Good understanding of quality methodology and metrics. Proficient in MS Office tools. Good command over English and Hindi, with excellent verbal and written communication. Strong interpersonal skills and a customer service mindset. Comfortable working from office in Bangalore. Good to Have (Advantage) Hands-on experience with voice bot or conversational AI quality, including AI audit frameworks and bot evaluation. Experience building or adapting audit scorecards for AI-led or automated customer interactions.

 learning, growth and shared wins along the way. Whether youre shaping the future of 
 fintech products or driving innovation behind the scenes, life at Navi means being part 
 of a high-energy, talent-driven workplace where your contributions truly make a

title: Student Relationship Manager
description:
Job Title: Student Relationship Manager 
 Entry-Level | Individual Contributor | Campus-Based 
 About the Role 
 We're hiring a Student Relationship Manager to be the single, non-academic point of contact for a mapped cohort of around 180 students on campus. This is an entry-level, high-visibility role for someone calm under pressure who genuinely enjoys helping people and owns a problem until it's actually closed not just logged. You'll be the first person students turn to for anything outside the classroom: hostel, mess, transport, fees, documentation, campus facilities, or simply needing to be heard. 
 Mandatory Requirements 
 0–1 years of experience — freshers are encouraged to apply Any graduate (bachelor's degree), any academic stream Excellent verbal and written communication skills Natural empathy and active listening — able to hear someone out fully without rushing to judgment or a canned response Calm and steady under pressure Proactive and self-starting — follows up and closes loops without needing to be chased Comfortable with basic tracker/spreadsheet discipline and a weekly reporting rhythm Willing to be based on campus full-time and work the academic calendar — this is not a remote or hybrid role 
 Good to Have 
 Prior experience in a people-facing or service role — even part-time, an internship, or volunteering Familiarity with student life, hostels, or a residential campus environment 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Be the single point of contact every mapped student knows to go to for any non-academic issue Log, categorize, and route issues to the right owner (facilities, warden, finance, transport) with an SLA, and track to closure Run a standing cadence of check-ins to catch disengagement, attendance drops, or dissatisfaction early Own the NPS of the mapped cohort — run the feedback loop and act on what's driving detractor scores Liaise with campus administration and facility vendors on recurring issues Maintain a live issue tracker and share a weekly dashboard with Program Ops 
 Ideal Backgrounds Psychology, social work, HR, or hospitality management graduates; BPO/voice and chat customer service freshers; hospitality and aviation entry-role candidates (front office, guest relations, cabin crew trainees); campus placement candidates with strong extracurricular signals (NSS, student council, peer counselling); ed-tech/ed-services customer success or student-counselling freshers. Growth Path Strong performers with consistent NPS ownership and tracker discipline are the natural pipeline into the Student Relationship Senior Manager role as regions expand.

title: Customer Relationship Manager
description:
ROLE OVERVIEW As a Customer Relationship Manager (CRM) at Lenskart, you will be the face of the store the first person a customer meets and the last impression they carry. You will own the end-to-end in-store experience, ensuring every visitor feels welcomed, heard, and valued. Beyond warm hospitality, you will play a critical role in resolving escalations, managing difficult situations with grace, and turning dissatisfied customers into loyal advocates. 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Customer Greeting & Experience Management Welcome every customer entering the store with warmth and professionalism, setting a positive first impression from the door. Understand customer needs proactively and guide them to the right product, service, or associate within the store. Acknowledge and manage wait times; keep customers engaged and comfortable during peak hours. Coordinate seamless handoffs between optometrists, sales associates, and the CRM desk. Grievance Resolution & Customer Recovery Own all in-store customer complaints from product defects and service delays to prescription concerns. Resolve grievances at the store level within defined TATs; escalate with full context when required. Maintain a complaint log and follow up post-resolution to confirm customer satisfaction. Identify recurring complaint patterns and flag them to store leadership and the operations team. Difficult Customer Handling Manage irate or highly dissatisfied customers with empathy, patience, and solution orientation. De-escalate tense situations through active listening and calm, composed communication. Exercise judgment on goodwill gestures (replacement, priority service, escalation) within authorized limits. Store Experience & CRM Operations Maintain store ambience, queue management, and signage in the customer-facing zone. Capture customer feedback (NPS, in-store forms) and share weekly insights with the store team. Track daily footfall, walk-in-to-conversion ratios, and complaint resolution metrics. Coordinate with the post-sales and fulfilment team for order status updates and delivery queries. 
 WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR Must-Have 1–4 years of experience in customer-facing roles — hospitality (hotel front desk, concierge), premium retail, airport lounge, or mall guest services. Demonstrated ability to handle difficult, unhappy, or demanding customers with composure and empathy. Fluency in Kannada and English; Hindi is a strong advantage. Warm, approachable personality with a solution-first and ownership mindset. Graduate in any discipline. 
 Good to Have Background from premium malls (UB City, Phoenix, Palladium), 5-star hotel front desks (Taj, Oberoi, Leela), or airport lounges (Encalm, Plaza Premium). Familiarity with CRM tools, complaint ticketing systems, or basic store management software. Prior exposure to eyewear, healthcare retail, or regulated product categories. Comfort with basic data entry — logging complaints, updating resolution status, sharing daily reports. 
 CORE COMPETENCIES Customer Empathy Acknowledges emotions before jumping to solutions; makes every customer feel heard and respected. Conflict De-escalation Stays calm under pressure; reframes complaints into resolvable problems without getting defensive. Service Ownership Does not pass the buck; sees every complaint through to closure personally. Communication Clear, polite, and confident in both Kannada and English; adapts tone to the customer. Attention to Detail Notices potential service gaps proactively and addresses them before they escalate. Adaptability Maintains service quality consistently across high-footfall peak hours and quieter periods.

description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI\-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.


By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer\-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real\-time insights.


Today, 1,900\+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**What will you do:**


The CCaaS Platinum Support Account Manager is the main technical support contact serving Sprinklr’s largest and most complex customers. We work with program managers and executive level decision makers at large enterprise brands to deliver excellent customer support experience. Platinum Support also acts as an internal escalation point, collaborating with Sales, Customer Success \& Services to resolve issues. The PSAM also acts as the day\-to\-day internal escalation point, and point of contact for clients, ensuring optimal client service as it relates to platform performance, functionality, enhancements, and configuration while supporting line management and operational excellence.

**Responsibilities:**

* Serve as the technical voice of the customer and advocate for your clients’ needs when escalating product issues.
* Be an expert on the Client’s custom implementation and be able to resolve issues pertaining to their setup that doesn’t require engineering intervention
* Meet regularly with your customer contacts for Case Reviews. You’ll cover trends you see in support tickets, look for opportunities to reduce pain points in product use, and deliver updates on outstanding issues.
* Collaborate regularly with other members of the account team to address reported issues and support their efforts.
* Attend bridge calls for escalated issues and work directly with the customer and engineering for expedited resolution.
* Plan and execute important events for customers in collaboration with success/MS team
* Prepare regular reports for internal stakeholders for all your accounts to highlight customer health index and plat of action to improve.
* Share regular insights into new product features with customer
* Discuss and plan release readiness with customer to meet customer expectations and ensure faster resolution on release related issues.
* Closely monitor TTR for all support cases from your accounts and always ensure adherence to SLA.
* Roll up your sleeve and work with support/engineering teams to debug critical issues reported by your accounts.
* Ensure the highest standard of service delivery to our platinum customers.
* Expertise in business analysis, functional specification, system design, platform configuration, testing, and training while assisting in operational housekeeping. This includes:
* Provide social insights and recommendations to support clients’ business practices
* Design and configure the appropriate Sprinklr solution to meet all requirements based on best practices and client’s custom needs, adhering to primary business use cases and platform functionalities
* Perform health checks of existing customers in need of platform upgrades and suggest solutions based on best practices and client needs.
* Provide consulting advise to clients about Sprinklr platform during different phases of project implementation

**What makes you qualified?**


* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Fluent in English
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
* A drive to dig into the details of a system or process to solve customer problems.
* Desire and ability to rapidly learn a wide variety of new technical skills.
* Self\-motivated, takes initiative, assumes ownership.
* Ability to work in a highly collaborative and fast\-paced environment.
* Graduation from Tier\-1 College.
* Strong customer handling skills and willingness to serve customers across various time zones. This role will be predominantly to support our U.S based customers so the candidate is expected to support U.S time zones. Occasionally work on weekends may be required as per business needs.

  

  

**Technical Skills**

* Experience deploying Voice and Non\-Voice Contact center applications like Genesys Engage, Amazon Connect, Cisco Webex Contact Center, Ring Central etc.
* Good Knowledge of Voice protocols like TCP/IP, VOIP, UDP, SIP, RTP, SRTP, WebRTC, audio processing
* Should have knowledge in CTI or Voice recording products
* Experience on VOIP, Dialer, ACD, IVR, SBC
* Exposure and understanding of video conferencing, IM, Voicemail, DID, carriers, knowledge of VOIP and SIP.
* Knowledge of UCaaS, CPaaS platform, Cloud, Contact Center, Integrations like MS teams, and analysis tools like Wireshark, etc.
* Familiar with Salesforce Service Cloud or similar CRM systems, KB systems, and Customer portals for case management
* At least two years' experience with telecom, call center integration, and VoIP, including developing and deploying code that directly interacts with SIP protocols, rtp packets, and the like.
* Experience in Groovy and Javascript.

**We focus on our mission**: Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI\-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified\-CXM.
* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.

**We believe in our product**: Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no\-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.

 **We invest in our people**: We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well\-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.


To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.


To learn more about all\-things\-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.

**EEO \- Our philosophy**: Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful.


Sprinklr is proud to be an equal\-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.

  

Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter.

**Warning about Recruiting Scams:** Please be vigilant for recruiting scams impersonating Sprinklr. Sprinklr will never ask you for money, to pay for equipment, or for unnecessary personal information during the interview process. Sprinklr will also never pay in Bitcoin or send email communications from our executives. Please review the Federal Trade Commission's advice to avoid these types of scams.


If you are contacted by someone whom you suspect may not be appropriately representing Sprinklr, please do not engage and block their email or phone number immediately.

 We are looking for a high-performing Manager to oversee our end-to-end Customer Care operations (Voice & Email channels). You will be responsible for driving daily operational excellence, ensuring strict SLA/TAT compliance, structuring operational workflows, and managing team performance during night hours. The ideal candidate has direct experience scaling processes, standardizing SOPs, and keeping customer satisfaction high while managing nocturnal team dynamics.

Design robust Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), templates, and escalation protocols tailored to night shift demands.  Job Purpose 
 We are looking for a high-performing Manager to oversee our end-to-end Customer Care operations (Voice & Email channels). You will be responsible for driving daily operational excellence, ensuring strict SLA/TAT compliance, structuring operational workflows, and managing team performance during night hours. The ideal candidate has direct experience scaling processes, standardizing SOPs, and keeping customer satisfaction high while managing nocturnal team dynamics.

Design robust Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), templates, and escalation protocols tailored to night shift demands. Drive continuous process improvement to eliminate workflow bottlenecks and improve first-contact resolution (FCR). 2. TAT & SLA Management Monitor and enforce target Turnaround Times (TAT) for email queues and key Call Center metrics (ASA, AHT, Service Level, Abandonment Rate). Implement live real-time queue monitoring systems to prevent backlog build-up and maintain performance during peak night traffic. Team Leadership & People Management Directly manage, lead, and mentor Team Leaders, Quality Analysts, and Customer Support Agents working on the night shift. Drive employee engagement and retention strategies specific to night shift employees to minimize burnout and attrition. 4. Quality, Reporting & Governance Collaborate with the QA team to establish quality benchmarks and monitor interaction standards across both email and call interactions. Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly operational reports (TAT reports, CSAT/DSAT, call volume trends, agent productivity) for senior leadership. Act as the primary point of contact during night hours for critical production issues, technical escalations, or emergency situations.

title: Area Manager
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE: 
 We are looking for an enthusiastic Area Manager with strong management and operational skills to oversee existing and upcoming restaurants. The ideal candidate should have experience in the QSR or FMCG industry and be responsible for driving sales, profitability, operational excellence, and team performance while ensuring California Burrito standards and customer expectations are consistently met. 
 Locations: Bengaluru | NCR | Pune | Mumbai | Chennai 
 THE IDEAL CANDIDATE: 
 Area Manager is responsible for the overall Business operations of the allocated restaurants according to California Burrito operational standards and run profitable business. A majority of time is spent leading/Guiding and coaching the team to meet Guest expectations, achieving both bottom and topline objectives by the guiding ambition of our organization. 
 Looking for someone who is from QSR or FMCG industry. 
 ROLES/RESPONSIBILITIES: 
 1) LEAD GREAT RESTAURANTS 
 Own the performance of your allotted restaurants and Strive for Excellence across operations, hospitality, food safety, sanitation and cleanliness. Lead from the front. Model great hospitality, coach restaurant teams and remove anything getting in the way of a great guest experience. Empower teams to resolve guest concerns quickly, thoughtfully and for the long term. Spot problems and opportunities early, build clear action plans and make sure they get done. 
 2) BUILD TEAMS THAT KEEP GROWING 
 Build an Open & Honest culture where every team member is treated fairly and respectfully. Develop restaurant leaders and their teams through strong training, regular coaching, meaningful recognition and clear accountability. Set clear goals, share performance openly and give teams Freedom with Ownership to deliver results. Stay flexible and step in wherever the business needs you most. 
 3) DRIVE HEALTHY GROWTH 
 Own sales, costs and profitability across your restaurants, monitoring every cost line against the annual business plan. Regularly review performance with your direct reports, conduct gap analysis and help every restaurant stay on target and achieve its bottom-line incentive. Understand and execute all in-store marketing promotions, while sharing relevant market-level inputs for national marketing across digital, print and other channels. Lead new product rollouts, support new restaurant openings and drive strong sales across new and existing locations. 
 4) KEEP EVERYONE MOVING TOGETHER 
 Work closely with support teams to solve problems, align on business priorities and turn plans into action. Communicate goals, results and next steps clearly so every team understands what they are working towards and how they contribute. Keep growing everyday. Ask for feedback, share ideas and keep finding better ways to work. 
 MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS 
 5+ years of experience in QSR Graduate in any discipline; Hospitality/Hotel Management preferred. Relevant experience in Cafes, QSR, Restaurant or Hospitality Prior experience managing multiple outlets/stores is preferred. Strong leadership, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Strong understanding of sales, P&L, people management, inventory, and operations. Highly customer-focused, energetic, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment. 
 SALARY 
 Will depend on experience. Upto 10 LPA (including incentives). Local conveyance will be covered by company.
